simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָעוּף (H4588) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מָעוּף (mâʻûwph) means darkness First listed occurrence: Isa 8 22.

definitions.full: H4588. mauph [ מָעוּף ] noun [masculine] id.; — construct צוּקָה מְעוּף Isa 8:22 (|| הֲשֵׁכָה ); Che Hpt. reads מוּעַף . תְּעֻפָה noun feminine id.; — so read probably for תָּעֻ֫פָה Job 11:17 (opposed to כֹּקֶר ).
definitions.rootNote: from 5774 in the sense of covering with shade (compare 4155 );
